definitions.BASELINE_ADVANTAGE: Both arms and all seven primary checks are complete and valid, parity passes, and Baseline passes more primary checks than System. This is a distinct formal disposition and entails no System measurable advantage.
definitions.INCONCLUSIVE: Identity, parity, and two-arm execution validity are intact, but the frozen evaluator cannot produce a complete Boolean result for every primary check, or evaluation fails after complete raw evidence is durably preserved. No winner is assigned.
definitions.INVALID_MEASUREMENT: The causal measurement contract is violated or cannot be established, including identity failure, parity failure, incomplete or one-arm execution, invalid raw-result identity, or authorization/transaction invalidity. No winner is assigned.
definitions.NO_MEASURABLE_ADVANTAGE: Both arms and all seven primary checks are complete and valid, parity passes, and their unweighted primary-check pass counts are equal. Equality is not evidence of equivalence outside this slice.
definitions.SYSTEM_MEASURABLE_ADVANTAGE: Both arms and all seven primary checks are complete and valid, parity passes, and System passes more primary checks than Baseline. This is bounded Mode-A Q2 evidence only.

evaluation_rule.rationale: P3.22B prospectively excludes E4 as diagnostic-only and keeps the other included families as primary; this contract adds no further exception or importance judgment.

result_blindness: Frozen before Formal P3.22 Q2 execution; no Q2 outcome was executed or inspected and expected_winner remains null.
